title: Fairy Rider on Cosmic Wolf
description: A glowing yellow insectoid fairy with large translucent wings rides a sleek black wolf with luminous golden eyes. They float above a colorful geometric tiled floor while carrying a large sparkling green orb, set against a swirling rainbow nebula and starry night sky.
prompt: A luminous yellow fairy with insect-like features and large translucent wings riding a sleek black wolf with glowing golden eyes. The wolf is leaping through space while carrying a large sparkling green orb with magical patterns. They float above a vibrant geometric tiled floor with dripping colorful patterns. The background is a swirling cosmic rainbow nebula and starry night sky with floating orbs, in a highly detailed surreal fantasy style.
